---
name: Cross-team handoff
about: Hand a finding or task to the subgroup that owns the affected code
title: "[Handoff] <short description> (<from team> -> <to team>)"
---

<!--
Do NOT use this template for real vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, or
anything that would help an attacker. Report those privately in Teams to the
relevant team lead. Package names and versions are fine here; CVE-level
exploit detail is not.
-->

## What
<!-- One or two lines: what looks wrong or what needs doing. -->

## Where
<!-- File paths, workflow names, run links or PR numbers. -->

## Why it matters
<!-- Impact in plain language. What breaks or gets riskier if nothing happens? -->

## Suggested fix
<!-- Optional. A starting point, not an instruction. -->

## Suggested urgency
<!-- Our suggestion only. The receiving team decides. e.g. "Before Sprint 2 planning", "No rush", "Blocking CI". -->

## How it was found
<!-- Command, tool or steps, so someone else can reproduce it. -->

## Related
- Planner card: <!-- link or ID -->
- Found by / contact: <!-- name -->

## Receiving team
<!-- Team and lead. Please acknowledge and assign an owner. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Contains no secrets, tokens or credentials
- [ ] Not a vulnerability that should be reported privately
- [ ] Planner card created and linked
- [ ] Team lead pinged in the AutoAudit chat with this link
